content.short: Kontigo is a USDC super app for Latinos to save, spend and send digital dollars with a card and wallet.
content.description: Kontigo is a stablecoin super app built for Latinos across the United States and Latin America, giving them a USDC account to store, send and spend digital dollars. Its Kontigo Cash self-custodial wallet, Kontigo Card and Kontigo Pay let people hold USDC, make instant cross-border transfers and pay through more than 30 local methods, while merchants can accept payments too. Aimed at users who need dependable access to dollars, Kontigo wraps stablecoin infrastructure in a consumer-friendly banking experience with a card for everyday purchases. Backed by a 20 million dollar seed round, its clients include Yummy and Burger King in Latin America.
content.meta: Kontigo is a USDC super app and card for Latinos to save, send and spend dollars. Discover Kontigo and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
